epic.title: Office restart: measurements kept, mood boards, the signature panels
epic.description:
The office starts again: only the measurements carry over, marked 'do not re-derive'. It goes through the same mood-board process as every room, last in the order, with its budget set when its turn comes. Fixed inputs: a solid oak or ash 2 m desktop on the right wall, the 3D-printed 'Mycelium' wall panels as the signature piece, ply overlay and firm underlay under click flooring, steel sheet for a writable wall, the flue sealed. The 3D printer is wanted but sits behind the baby and bathroom spend.

## Order
office.01 and office.02 record what is kept (any time after home.02). office.07 (hotkeys) is independent. The rest waits for the office's turn: office.03 mood boards after home.19, then office.04 budget, office.05 walls (linked to GARDN-1), office.06 the printer. The Access to Work equipment application is an undecided item in the LIFE review (review.02), not a ticket.

## Done means
The office is designed, budgeted and finished through the room process, with the signature panels on the wall.

## Flags
- H4: the 3D-printed 'Mycelium' wall panels replace section 8b's 'a quiet nod in his office only'. Not reopened.

## Dossier
The dossier is attached in Docs (link filled by the integrator).

tickets.title: Measurements carried over, marked "do not re-derive": shell 3500 by 4900 by 2450, alcove, chimney breast, windows, door, radiator, clear run 2500; entered in the editor
tickets.description:
## What
Enter the office's kept measurements into the editor exactly as given, marked 'do not re-derive': shell 3500 wide, 4900 deep, 2450 high; alcove front-right 1050 deep with a 460 beam drop; chimney breast on the left wall projecting 360 with recesses of 1460 and 2220; two windows 1650 wide, sill 740; door on the right wall; radiator on the back wall; clear right-wall run 2500 (all millimetres). The source file office-design-state.md is not in this repo; the figures here come from Phil's answer in the intake (H4). When rescue.01 brings the file into claude/archive/, check the figures against it and note any difference rather than changing them.

## Why
Phil decided the office starts again and only the measurements carry over, marked 'do not re-derive'.

## Done looks like
The office appears in the editor with these figures, a 'do not re-derive' note on the room, and a line saying whether rescue.01's file agrees.

## Unlocks
office.03: the mood boards use the room.

## Depends on
home.02: the editor holds rooms.

tickets.title: Walls patched and repaired
tickets.description:
## What
Survey the office walls by tapping for hollow plaster, outline each area, fill the small ones, and cut back and patch the large ones. Anything over about a square metre is a plastering job for the learn-it-or-hire-it decision (home.20). GARDN-1 ('Patch and repair office walls') is the existing ticket for this; this guide gives it the steps and the two are linked.

## Why
The office restarts through the room process; walls are repaired before it is decorated.

## Done looks like
Every outlined area filled or patched and sanded flush.

## Unlocks
The office decoration from its mood board.

## Depends on
office.03: the board is picked, so the repair matches the finish. home.20 for any large area.

intro.answer: Find the loose and damaged plaster, fill small damage, patch larger areas, and seal for paint.
time: About 45 minutes over three sittings, plus drying

steps.title: Tap the walls
steps.body_html: Tap each wall with a knuckle or the handle of a screwdriver. A hollow sound is loose plaster. Outline each area in pencil.

steps.title: Sort by size
steps.body_html: List each area: small (a filler job, smaller than a hand) or large (a plaster patch). Anything bigger than about a square metre goes to the learn-it-or-hire-it decision (home.20).
steps.expect_html: A list with small or large per area.

steps.title: Rake out and fill
steps.body_html: Rake out cracks and holes, brush the dust off, dampen, and fill slightly proud with filler.

steps.title: Sand when dry
steps.body_html: Sand flush once dry (the filler tub gives the time).

steps.title: Remove loose plaster
steps.body_html: Cut back the loose plaster to sound edges.

steps.title: Patch
steps.body_html: Seal or dampen the background as the plaster bag says, then fill in layers and flatten with a straight edge.

tickets.title: 3D printer purchase (PLA and PETG only), behind the baby and bathroom spend
tickets.description:
## What
Choose and buy a 3D printer for the signature 'Mycelium' wall panels, printing PLA and PETG only (no resin, no high-temperature materials). It sits in the office room plan and is bought only after the baby and bathroom spend. Claude can prepare a short comparison of two or three printers at the time, because models and prices change fast.

## Why
Phil decided the 3D printer is not bought yet but still wanted, PLA and PETG only, behind the baby and bathroom spend.

## Done looks like
A printer chosen, priced and on the office shopping list, bought when the budget allows.

## Unlocks
The 3D-printed wall panels.

## Depends on
office.04: the office budget.

## Cost
To be priced at the time. Nothing is bought in this run.

tickets.title: Window hotkeys: trial the two AutoHotkey scripts for a week from the keyboard
tickets.description:
## What
Find the two AutoHotkey window scripts from July, check whether they are written for AutoHotkey v1 or v2 (v1 scripts do not run under v2 unchanged), install the matching AutoHotkey, set them to start on login, and use them from the keyboard for a week before deciding to keep, change or drop them.

## Why
Phil wanted one small ticket to trial the two scripts for a week from the keyboard; MIDI pads are an idea behind it.

## Done looks like
A verdict (keep, change or drop) after a week.

## Unlocks
Nothing.

## Depends on
Nothing (the scripts may need rescue.01 if they are only in the chats).

steps_definition.title: Window hotkeys: a week's trial of the two AutoHotkey scripts

intro.answer: Install AutoHotkey, run the two July scripts, and use them from the keyboard for a week before deciding.
to_hand: The two scripts (from the July chats, through rescue.01 if not on the PC)
time: About 15 minutes, then a week of use

sources.label: AutoHotkey forum: v1 snap script not working on Windows 11 and v2

steps.title: Find the scripts
steps.body_html: Find the two .ahk files. If they are not on the PC, they are in the July office chats and come through rescue.01.

steps.title: Check the version
steps.body_html: Open each file. A line #Requires AutoHotkey v2 means version 2. Old v1 scripts do not run under v2 as they are.

steps.title: Install AutoHotkey
steps.body_html: Install the version the scripts need from the official download page.
steps.expect_html: Double-clicking a script shows the green H icon in the tray.

steps.title: Start on login
steps.body_html: Press Win+R, type the value below, and put a shortcut to each script there.

troubleshooting.symptom: A window lands in the wrong place
troubleshooting.fix: Display scaling can offset positions; tell Claude the monitor layout and scaling.

steps.title: Trial for a week
steps.body_html: Use the hotkeys for a week from the keyboard, then write keep, change or drop. MIDI pads are an idea behind this, not part of it.
